concept: How an entailment guard reverts an unsupported LLM claim: token grounding sees words that exist somewhere in the corpus, but cannot see which employer a claim belongs to. Entailment asks whether the claim is supported by that bullet's own evidence.
expertise_anchor: Built in aether-job-career-agent resume_tailor.py: deterministic token grounding rejects absent tokens; semantic fabrications like attaching 'for financial institutions' to the wrong employer still pass token checks. Entailment verifier returns one verdict per bullet; not entailed reverts to the original; verifier failure reverts every change.
